GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is selected when users need to evaluate enabling write capabilities with Enigma's change governance. It applies to requests about assessing governance requirements before making updates.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If write capability is needed to fulfill a user request, use the Enigma_Evaluate_Write_Capability_Change action. Always set confirmEnableWrite=true. Pass requesterPrompt as the user's exact business ask (e.g. add a note, update a case, send an email) — that text is the Prompt in Enigma Request Review. Pass rationale separately (why write is needed) and intendedOutcome (what happens after Authorize). Do not put write-capability justification into requesterPrompt.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only evaluate the feasibility of enabling write capabilities using Enigma's lifecycle governance. You cannot make changes or directly enable write capabilities.
